legend: Consider the following graph in the shape of n%%ZSMJ0%% equilateral triangles stitched together horizontally:
This graph has n+2%%ZSMJ1%% vertices and 2n+1%%ZSMJ2%% edges. The vertices are labeled in the order of increasing horizontal position, as in the image above.
In other words, the graph has n+2%%ZSMJ3%% vertices labeled from 1%%ZSMJ4%% through n+2%%ZSMJ5%%, and 2n+1%%ZSMJ6%% edges connecting all pairs of vertices whose labels differ by at most 2%%ZSMJ7%%.

A positive integer value is assigned to each vertex. Vertex i%%ZSMJ8%% has the value of vi%%ZSMJ9%%. The value of an edge that connects vertices i%%ZSMJ10%% and j%%ZSMJ11%% is |vi−vj|%%ZSMJ12%%. Find a way to assign values to all vertices so that for every positive integer k%%ZSMJ13%% up to 2n+1%%ZSMJ14%% inclusive, exactly one edge has the value of k%%ZSMJ15%%. The value of any vertex cannot exceed 1018%%ZSMJ16%%.
input: The first line contains n%%ZSMJ17%%, a positive integer.
output: If a solution exists for the given n%%ZSMJ18%%, print the values assigned to the vertices 1,2,…,n+2%%ZSMJ19%% in one line, separated by spaces. The values must be positive integers not exceeding 1018%%ZSMJ20%%. Otherwise, print −1%%ZSMJ21%%.
